'''Chin Ellisor''' is captain of the ''[[Blue Crane]]'' and a native of [[Tar Valon]].

==Activities==
Captain Ellisor captains the ''Blue Crane'' down the [[River Erinin]] with [[Elayne Trakand]], [[Egwene al'Vere]], and [[Nynaeve al'Meara]]. That is, until they run afoul of a mudflat near [[Jurene]].{{ref/book|3|37}}
